description: Defines a NotificationManager struct responsible for handling user notifications, including permission checks, content configuration, and sending notifications asynchronously.

classes.name: NotificationManager
classes.description: A struct managing the creation and dispatching of user notifications, including permission handling and content configuration.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a notification with specified title, body, sound, and optional priority, handling permission requests and setting content properties accordingly.
